Account and plan access

Only account credentials and plan access are handled here. Never enter complaints, party identities, evidence or case details. The inquiry guide processes selections in your open browser session.

Sign in with an email code

No password or authenticator app is needed. Use the email approved for your account.

The newest code expires after ten minutes and can be used once. Keep codes private.

Use a password and authenticator instead
Need an account or password reset?

Your plan provider provisions access after verifying your purchase. Ask them to create your confirmed account or arrange a verified password reset. Account support never needs your case files. Email codes do not create accounts or activate a purchase. Ask your provider to create and approve your account first.
